name: Born Again

provenance.detail: Josh opens Look and Live by naming the series goal as examining whether you are truly born again, later flags born again as the series title, and on April 27 says today marks the end of a three-week series titled Born Again.

description: Nicodemus and new birth in John 3, opened across three weeks.
note: Josh names this as a three-week series through John 3. Week one is new birth, week two is John 3:16 and initiating love, week three is the already-rendered verdict in John 3:19-21.
